# kala_customer (Data Source)

Looks up a single customer by `id`, `number`, or `cvr`. Set exactly one.

Kala has **no single-customer endpoint**. `number` and `cvr` are narrowed upstream before matching, so they do not read the whole account; `id` cannot be, because Kala's query parameter searches text.

If the account is larger than the read can cover, the lookup reports that the read was incomplete rather than claiming the customer does not exist.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Set exactly one of id, number, or cvr.
#
# `cvr` and `number` are narrowed upstream before matching, so they do not read
# the whole account. `id` cannot be — Kala's query parameter searches text — so
# an id lookup reads the list and selects from it.

data "kala_customer" "by_cvr" {
  cvr = "12345678"
}

data "kala_customer" "by_number" {
  number = "K-001"
}

data "kala_customer" "by_id" {
  id = 1
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `cvr` (String) Look up by Danish CVR registration number. Narrowed upstream before matching.
- `id` (Number) Look up by Kala's internal customer id. Unlike the other selectors this cannot be narrowed upstream -- Kala's `query` parameter searches text -- so an id lookup reads the customer list and selects from it.
- `include_contact_details` (Boolean) Expose email, phone, address, zip, city, and ean. Off by default.
- `number` (String) Look up by customer number, e.g. `K-001`. Narrowed upstream before matching.

### Read-Only

- `address` (String) Street address. **Null unless `include_contact_details` is set** -- contact data is personal data and everything exposed here is written to Terraform state.
- `case_count` (Number) How many cases reference this customer.
- `city` (String) City. **Null unless `include_contact_details` is set** -- contact data is personal data and everything exposed here is written to Terraform state.
- `company` (String) Company name.
- `ean` (String) EAN number used for invoicing. **Null unless `include_contact_details` is set** -- contact data is personal data and everything exposed here is written to Terraform state.
- `email` (String) Email address. **Null unless `include_contact_details` is set** -- contact data is personal data and everything exposed here is written to Terraform state.
- `first_name` (String) Contact's first name.
- `last_name` (String) Contact's last name.
- `phone` (String) Phone number. **Null unless `include_contact_details` is set** -- contact data is personal data and everything exposed here is written to Terraform state.
- `zip` (String) Postal code. **Null unless `include_contact_details` is set** -- contact data is personal data and everything exposed here is written to Terraform state.
